summary: Implemented Graph.cbd(resource) in rdflib/graph.py as the last method of Graph, before ConjunctiveGraph, with a nested recursive helper add_to_cbd covering the three CBD rules (rule 3 reification has no rdf:Statement or predicate/object matching). Added test/test_graph_cbd.py with CbdTestCase (setUp parses a Turtle fixture, tearDown closes the graph) covering rule 1/2 counts, empty result, typed and untyped reifiers, incoming-reification exclusion, blank-node non-expansion under reifiers, blank-node cycles, and source immutability, with a __main__ guard. No commits made, and no tests or linters were run; the expected counts come from hand calculation on my own fixture and are unverified.
